_comment: Single source of truth for role access. Read by backend/core/policy.py and frontend/src/policy/policy.ts. Anything not listed is denied.

actions.auth.login: Sign in with a role tab
actions.auth.otp_verify: Check the emailed 6-digit code and start the customer session
actions.auth.session: Read the current session (or none) and renew it from the refresh cookie
actions.auth.password_reset: Request a customer password reset email
actions.auth.password_reset_confirm: Set a new password from a reset link
actions.auth.invite_check: Read a staff invite from its link
actions.auth.invite_accept: Set a password from a staff invite link
actions.dev.mailbox: Read the simulated email outbox (development only)
actions.staff.invites.resend: Resend a staff invite with a new link
actions.public.site: Read website content (home page and footer)
actions.public.page: Read a policy page (privacy, terms, cancellation)
actions.booking.options: Read booking sheet options for a service
actions.booking.slots: List free start times and the price for a service choice
actions.my.appointments.list: List my own booking requests and appointments
actions.my.appointments.read: Read one of my own appointments
actions.my.appointments.update: Cancel, flag (I'm here, reschedule, cancel request) or resend the payment link for my own appointment
actions.my.payment.read: Read the payment due for my own appointment
actions.my.payment.pay: Pay for my own appointment (mock gateway)
actions.my.invoices.read: Read one of my own invoices
actions.my.ratings.list: List my visits that are waiting for a rating
actions.my.ratings.submit: Rate my stylist for one of my own paid visits (once)
actions.desk.appointments.list: List all booking requests and appointments
actions.desk.appointments.read: Read one appointment with confirm options
actions.desk.appointments.confirm: Confirm a request (stylist, time, room) and send a payment link
actions.desk.appointments.reject: Reject a request with a reason
actions.desk.appointments.move: Move a held or scheduled booking to another stylist, room or time
actions.desk.appointments.cancel: Cancel a held, scheduled or checked-in booking (reason required)
actions.desk.appointments.no_show: Mark a scheduled booking as a no-show after its start time
actions.desk.appointments.dismiss: Decline a customer's reschedule or cancel request
actions.desk.schedule.read: Read one day of the schedule by stylist and room
actions.desk.appointments.check_in: Check a scheduled guest in on the day of the visit
actions.desk.bookings.create: Book a walk-in or phone customer and list free times for it
actions.desk.customers.list: Search customers by name, email or full mobile number
actions.desk.customers.create: Register a customer at the desk
actions.desk.customers.read: Read a customer with visit history and front-desk notes
actions.desk.customers.update: Edit a customer's name, phone, allergies or preferences
actions.desk.customers.notes: Add a front-desk note to a customer
actions.pos.read: Read the POS queue, a visit's checkout screen and a bill preview
actions.pos.checkout: Bill a visit: products, discount within the cap, loyalty points, tip, payments
actions.pos.refunds.request: Ask for a refund on an invoice (the admin refunds directly)
actions.pos.refunds.list: List refunds waiting for a decision
actions.cash.close.read: Read the day's takings and cash-close record
actions.cash.close.sign: Sign off the daily cash close
actions.work.ping: Tell the server the receptionist is active (keeps the session from idling out)
actions.hours.read: Read my own work sessions, hours and estimated pay
actions.staff.hours.read: Read a receptionist's work sessions, hours and estimated pay
actions.staff.hours.correct: Correct a receptionist's work session times (reason required)
actions.stylist.appointments.list: List my own visits (today, upcoming, past)
actions.stylist.appointments.read: Read one of my own visits: first name, services, allergy and preference notes, history with me
actions.stylist.appointments.start: Start the service on my own checked-in visit
actions.stylist.appointments.complete: Complete my own in-progress visit with the services really done and a note
actions.stylist.ratings.read: Read my own ratings and comments (no customer names)
actions.stylist.earnings.read: Read my own estimated pay for a month
actions.stylist.schedule.read: Read my working hours and days-off requests
actions.stylist.daysoff.withdraw: Withdraw a days-off request that is still waiting
actions.chat.threads.list: List my Zen Chat conversations (person cards with unread counts)
actions.chat.messages.list: Read the messages of one of my conversations
actions.chat.messages.send: Send a message in one of my conversations (REST fallback)
actions.chat.messages.read: Mark one of my conversations as read
actions.chat.ws.connect: Open the live Zen Chat connection for one of my conversations
actions.chat.ws.send: Send messages, typing and read signals over the live connection
actions.staff.details.read: Read a staff member's role-specific details (profile, services, hours)
actions.staff.details.update: Edit a stylist's profile, services, working hours and public visibility
actions.staff.details.link: Link a stylist account to a team profile
actions.staff.daysoff.decide: Approve or decline a days-off request
actions.catalogue.read: Read all categories, services and rooms (also hidden ones)
actions.catalogue.write: Create, edit and delete categories, services and rooms
actions.inventory.manage: Manage products and suppliers (never the stock level directly)
actions.inventory.stock: Receive, adjust or write off stock and read the stock ledger
actions.cash.close.review: See the receptionists' cash closes and mark them reviewed
actions.settings.business.update: Change the business settings (audited with old and new values)
actions.content.read: Read the public content blocks, drafts, FAQs and achievements
actions.content.edit: Edit content drafts, FAQs and achievements
actions.marketing.manage: Manage offers, coupons, loyalty rules and campaign drafts
actions.marketing.send: Send a campaign to opted-in customers
actions.public.unsubscribe: Unsubscribe from marketing messages with the emailed link
actions.audit.export: Download the audit log as CSV (the download is itself audited)
actions.security.view: See failed sign-ins, locked accounts and signed-in staff sessions
actions.security.sessions.revoke: Sign out another staff member's session
actions.datarequests.list: See customer data export and deletion requests
actions.datarequests.decide: Complete or decline a customer data request
actions.my.datarequests.create: Ask for my data or for my account to be deleted
actions.packages.read: See packages and what customers bought
actions.giftcards.read: See gift cards (last four characters only)
actions.giftcards.reveal: Reveal a gift card's full code (audited)
actions.sales.read: See package, membership and gift-card sales
actions.wallet.refund: Refund a package or put a used session back
actions.packages.cancel_requests.decide: Approve or reject a package cancellation request
actions.wallet.catalogue: See packages and plans on sale
actions.wallet.customer: See a customer's packages and membership at the counter
actions.wallet.sell: Sell a package, membership or gift card at the counter
actions.wallet.giftcheck: Check a gift card code at the counter
actions.my.wallet.read: See my packages, membership and gift cards
actions.my.packages.list: See my packages page (codes, ledger, cancellation requests)
actions.my.packages.reveal: See my package's full code again
actions.my.packages.cancel_estimate: See what cancelling a package would refund
actions.my.packages.cancel_request: Ask to cancel a package for a refund
actions.my.giftcards.reveal: See my gift card's full code again
actions.my.waitlist.respond: Accept or decline a freed slot
actions.auth.two_factor_verify: Check the authenticator (or backup) code and start the admin session
actions.twofactor.manage: Set up, use and switch off my own two-step sign-in
actions.twofactor.reset: Reset another admin's two-step sign-in (they lost their phone)
actions.purchasing.manage: Create, send, receive and close purchase orders; see a supplier's order history
actions.ratings.read: Admin: see every stylist's ratings, averages and comments
actions.ratings.moderate: Admin: put a rating under review, exclude it, or restore it (reason required)
actions.pay.read: Admin: see every stylist's estimated pay for a month with the breakdown
actions.work.admin.read: Admin: receptionists' hours, sessions that look wrong, punctuality, shifts and monthly pay
actions.work.shifts.update: Admin: set a receptionist's weekly shifts
actions.payroll.read: Admin: read payroll runs, lines and any payslip
actions.payroll.manage: Admin: draft, recalculate, adjust, approve and mark payroll as paid
actions.payslips.own: Read my own payslips (approved or paid runs only)
actions.staffsummary.read: Admin: Staff Summary numbers and graph series
actions.reviews.read: Admin: monthly performance review indicators and saved reviews
actions.reviews.write: Admin: save a monthly performance review (status and notes)
actions.chatbot.ask: Ask AI Alankar Intelligence a question (guests and customers; staff accounts are refused)
actions.chatbot.insights.read: Read the chatbot's unanswered questions (anonymous keys) and intent usage
actions.chatbot.insights.manage: Turn an unanswered chatbot question into an FAQ, or dismiss it (audited)
actions.chatbot.insights.test: Try a question in the chatbot test box (guest context, nothing logged)
actions.my.shop.quote: Price my cart (prices worked out by the server)
actions.my.orders.read: See one of my orders and its tracking timeline
actions.my.orders.cancel: Cancel my online order before it is packed
actions.orders.read: See one online order with the delivery address
actions.orders.advance: Mark an online order packed, shipped or delivered
actions.orders.cancel: Cancel an online order with a reason (refunds what was paid)

menu.description: Hair, skin and spa products delivered to your door: add to cart, pick an address, pay.

menu.label: My Wallet
menu.description: Your packages, membership and gift cards. Buy, renew or cancel.

menu.label: Waitlist
menu.description: Wait for a slot to open; accept an offer within the hold time.

menu.label: Profile
menu.description: Your contact details, allergies and preferences.

menu.label: Dashboard
menu.description: Today at the desk: new requests, held slots and customer requests that need you.

menu.label: Schedule
menu.description: Day schedule by stylist and room. Drag a visit to move it, or use Move to.

menu.label: Customers
menu.description: Search customers, open a profile with visit history and notes, register walk-ins and book them.

menu.label: POS / Billing
menu.description: Bill checked-in visits: products, discount within your limit, loyalty points, tip and payment. Invoices and refund requests.

menu.label: Orders
menu.description: Online shop orders: filter, open one, mark packed, shipped and delivered.

menu.label: Cash Close
menu.description: Today's takings by payment method, count the cash and sign off the day.

menu.label: Inventory (view)
menu.description: Products and stock levels, with a low-stock flag.

menu.label: My Hours & Pay
menu.description: Your worked hours (sign-in to sign-out) and what they earn at your hourly rate.

menu.label: My Day
menu.description: Today's visits as cards: start and complete your own services.

menu.label: My Appointments
menu.description: Your upcoming and past visits with what you need to know about each guest.

menu.label: My Schedule
menu.description: Your working hours, and days-off requests.

menu.label: Zen Chat
menu.description: Chat with the guests you have visits with. Phone numbers and emails are never shown.

menu.label: Earnings
menu.description: Your ratings, per-task earnings and estimated pay (view only).

menu.label: Dashboard
menu.description: Your overview. Business numbers arrive in Task 5.

menu.label: Appointments
menu.description: Booking requests as cards: confirm, reject, move, cancel, check in, or mark a no-show.

menu.label: Schedule
menu.description: Day schedule by stylist and room. Drag a visit to move it, or use Move to.

menu.label: Customers
menu.description: Search customers, open a profile with visit history and notes, register walk-ins and book them.

menu.label: Staff
menu.description: Team cards: invite, deactivate, edit stylist profile, services and hours, receptionist rate, and decide days-off requests.

menu.label: Ratings
menu.description: Each stylist's average, count and trend, customer comments, and review or exclusion of unfair ratings (never deleted).

menu.label: Work Hours
menu.description: Receptionists' sign-in sessions by month: hours, sessions that look wrong, corrections with a reason, weekly shifts, punctuality and monthly pay.

menu.label: Staff Summary
menu.description: Graphs per stylist, per receptionist and for the team (appointments, revenue, ratings, hours, earnings, no-shows) with month and range filters, and the monthly Performance Review.

menu.label: Payroll
menu.description: Monthly payroll: draft, review every line, add bonuses or deductions, approve, mark as paid, and open payslips. Includes the stylist pay breakdown.

menu.label: Services
menu.description: Services, options and add-ons, categories, rooms: prices, durations, GST, payouts. Changes show on the public site at once.

menu.label: POS / Billing
menu.description: Bill visits, see all invoices, decide and issue refunds (with stock and loyalty reversal), and review cash closes.

menu.label: Orders
menu.description: Online shop orders: filter, open one, mark packed, shipped and delivered, or cancel with a refund.

menu.label: Inventory
menu.description: Products, suppliers and the stock ledger: receive, adjust or write off stock, with low-stock alerts.

menu.label: Website
menu.description: Edit the public site: banner, about, announcements, FAQs, achievements and the Zenotians page, with a preview before publishing.

menu.label: Marketing
menu.description: Offers, coupons (rules, dates and limits), loyalty rules, and campaigns to customers who opted in.

menu.label: Packages & Plans
menu.description: Packages (bundles of sessions) and membership plans: define them, see who bought them, refund unused sessions.

menu.label: Package Requests
menu.description: Customers' requests to cancel a package for a pro-rata refund: approve (optionally at a different amount) or reject, with a reason.

menu.label: Gift Cards
menu.description: Gift cards sold, balances and ledger. Only the last four characters of a code are shown.

menu.label: Waitlist
menu.description: Customers waiting for a slot, the offers made, and removals.

menu.label: Reports
menu.description: Revenue by day, service, stylist and division, appointments, no-shows, top customers and product sales, with CSV export.

menu.label: Chatbot insights
menu.description: Questions the chatbot could not answer (anonymous), what people ask most, and a test box.

menu.label: Settings
menu.description: Shop details and GST number, opening hours, cancellation and payment-hold windows, discount cap, idle timeout and rating bands.

menu.label: Audit Log
menu.description: Who did what and when, with filters and a CSV download. Secrets are never shown.

menu.label: Security
menu.description: Failed sign-ins and locks, signed-in staff sessions, and customer data requests.
